label: When a Husband Chooses His Wife’s Last Name: Their Voices

tier_table.tv_ja: 長い文頭のWhether節と主節を区別し、主節の主語を探す。
tier_table.sentence: Whether a husband chooses his wife’s last name on the marriage registration form or joins her family as an adopted son, he and each of their families have their own feelings.
Here are the voices of three people with different situations and lives.

tier_table.tv_ja: It is/was ... whoの形では、who節の中の動詞と焦点となる人物を対応させる。
tier_table.sentence: It was my wife’s parents who worried, asking me again and again if I was really sure.

tier_table.tv_ja: find it + 形容詞 + that節では、itを形式目的語、形容詞を目的格補語として捉える。
tier_table.sentence: I still find it a little hard that I don’t get much time to myself while living at my wife’s parents’ home, but adjusting to the way each family does things was harder than changing my last name.

tier_table.tv_ja: 疑問文のIt-cleftでは、that節の中で焦点となる要素が何かを確かめる。
tier_table.sentence: But was it only the change of last name that I didn’t like?
He took his wife’s last name without discussing it with his parents, and I know that his mother, my aunt, was so shocked that she became ill.
